page.title: AI and agent creation
page.purpose: Direct and review bounded AI or agent-assisted creation with reference evidence, explicit data egress and aggregate spend control.

priorities.statement: Understand that AI or an agent will act and what it will send or spend.
Set the target, references, quality gates and limits.
Inspect iterations and stop safely without losing useful work.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Display AI/agent label, exact provider/model, uploaded media/derived content, expected/unknown price, aggregate cap and cancellation semantics before submission.
Wait for a specific missing decision without treating elapsed time as consent.
Show durable operations and receipts, remaining budget and observed versus estimated progress.
No provider call starts while cap enforcement or funding is unavailable.
Stop requested; do not claim stopped or refunded before confirmed.
Retain candidate, parameters, sources, cost evidence and unresolved visual/reference issues.

claims.statement: Every AI step and agent launch, including local inference, is conspicuously identified before action and remains attributable in history and artifact provenance.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: Creation enforces one aggregate budget across nested calls and exposes unknown cost or incomplete cancellation honestly.

claims.statement: Reference-based creation retains source comparisons and rejected iterations; a successful render cannot self-certify realism.

x-design.layout: Preflight summary and deliberate Start action before a durable step log; reference board and iteration comparison central, scope/budget/privacy visible throughout.
controls: Choose task: generate photographic plate, author device/scene, repair or qualify; inspect route capabilities
Attach rights-cleared references and mark dimensions measured/estimated/unknown
Choose provider/model or local agent, requested controls and known/unknown pricing
Preview upload manifest/redactions; approve per-project external media and scoped operation
Set total nested budget, per-step limits, time/resource/iteration caps and stop rule
Inspect requested versus honored generation controls, compare iterations, pause/stop and review candidate
details: No automatic image generation on page open, prompt typing, preview refresh or account connection.
Plate generation produces approximate photographed geometry, not a calibrated 3D asset.

Unknown pricing is never represented as a hard enforceable money cap; cost-bearing dispatch is blocked unless authoritative rates or an enforceable provider cap establish a safe upper bound within the aggregate ceiling.
Account, BYOK credential, provider availability, authority, privacy opt-in and budget are distinct checks.
Autonomous steps follow the authorized target and budget but never grant their own release approval.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.
